content: Awayabayababa
‘Havena tomowa am'awa'awa yababaedi mata dova ta Yaubada hinage i'awa yababaegomiu.
Wuwuna aiteya ginauli aidiyena tomowa am'awa yababaedi mata aidiyena Yaubada i'awa yababaegomiu, na hinage vedova mumugamiu tomowa aidiyai Yaubada dova hinage imumuga alimiyai.
‘Na nigele howahowana tahim ainai uwalo ebeha mehenai aiwa mu'amu'alina imiyamiya, wuwuna owa hinage mehemwai etupwa imiyamiya, ta nigele uya'ita.
Eeta havena tahim uwalowalo ainai ebeha aiwa mu'amu'alina mehenaena uvaivehulu, wuwuna owa hinage mehemwai etupwa imiyamiya.
Moiha tau'oyama ehebo owa, awa? Na hesi etupwane mehemwena uvaimugaiyei, na ainaena uvinunu ili'ilimani na mulitai abo tahimne mehenaena aiwa mu'amu'alina uvaivehulu.
‘Havena Yaubada yana paulao edewa umohemohedi, mata dova ta hita'wata'wataedi na hi'alahigo. Nigele howahowana hinage yami bagi maheya ammohemohedi mata dova ta hiwutuye bi'ibi'idi.
Awanoi vehabana
‘Am'awanoi, na Yaubada imohegomiu. Na ambeha ta amlobai. Na hinage am'aigohagoha ta awa'eda hiho'e.
Moiha ebe ta'awanoi, Yaubada imohegita na ebe tabeha howola abo talobai, na hinage ebe ta'aigohagoha awa'eda hiho'e vehabada.
‘Na vedova omiu hedaheda tamadiyao, ebe natumiyao ai'ai vehabana hi'awa'awanoi, mata gaima ammohedi?
Nuwana ebe yama vehabana hi'awa'awanoi weso ammohedi? Mata nigele!

Moiha omiu tauyababa, na yami aiyauya natumiyao aidiyai bada amhanahanapui, ebeha ginauli namwanamwa a'avadi ammohemohedi, dova hinage Tamamiu galewai, ebe am'awanoi ainai, ihanapuiya'o hava namwanamwana ilowoinanegomiu na imohegomiu.
‘Na ebe hava nuwanuwamiu na tomowa alimiyai hipaihowai omiu hinage dova aidiyai ampaihowai, wuwuna teina Mosese yo tauwalo mahalavao yadi loina ana uini.
Amwaha dinodinona
‘Amwaha dinodinona ainaena amluwu na havena amwaha tabatabana ainaena, neta abasilahe ana amwaha. Amwahane tabatabanane ana lau malamalaina, na ainaena tomowa bagibagilidi hilaulau.
Na yawahi namwanamwana ana amwaha ana lau vitaina na ana awa'eda dinodinona ta'i, ainaena tomowa vihavihadi hiluwuluwu.
Aiwa na ainona
‘Tauyewasao oya'oyama aidiyena am'ita avivinigomiu. Wuwuna mata tupwadi howola abo alimiyai hilaowa, adi ita dova sipi manamanahamdi, na holadiyai hesi dova edewa manimanini.
Na yadi paihowa aidiyena howola mata abo amhanapuidi. Wuwuna haihaili nigele howahowana na ainona iyemala sibweya. Buyubuyuwa hinage dova nigele howahowana na ainona iyemala damaya.
Wuwuna aiwa namwanamwadi ainodi ausaladi, na aiwa newanewalidi ainodi yababadi.
Neta moiha, aiwa ausaladi nigele howahowana na ainodi newanewalidi hi'ainowedi, na aiwa newanewalidi hinage dova nigele howahowana na ainodi namwanamwadi hi'ainowedi.
Ainaena ebe aiwa nigele hiya'aino namwanamwa tagoha vehuludi na tagabudi.
Dova hinage tauwalo mahalava oya'oyama yadi paihowa aidiyena howahowana amhanapuidi.
Tau'oyamao
‘Bagibagilidi aliguwai hi'awa'awa taubada na hesi mata nigele hiyaluwu Yaubada yana Abaloina ainai, na yaiyadiwo hiya Tamagu galewai yana walo ana taupaihowao hiya hibom.

Hauga ilalaoma ainai tomowa bagibagilidi howola abo aliguwai hiwalo, “Taubada vehabam apapaihowane, neta yehamwena awalo mahalava yo vi'avi'a tomowa aidiyena agabae mahalavaedi yo paihowa abanuwapwanopwano apapaihowaidine”.
‘Mata aidiyai yawalo, “Nigele yayahanapuigomiu yaiyadiwo omiu, amwuyo na havena amluwuluwuma wuwuna omiu tauyababao”.
Vada ana wahuwahu
‘Yagu walo teina ebe yaiya ibenaledi na ipaihowaidi iya dova ehebo tau'abi vada hanahanapuna, yana wahuwahu gaima ainai i'a'abine,
na mulitai 'wesu italu na abaita isagena yo hinage yaumai mwala'ina itowa na hesi yana vadane nigele iyabuiyei, wuwuna ana logidiwone gaima ainai hi'abi avivini'o.
‘Na ebe yaiya yagu walowone teina ibenaledi'o na nigele iyapaihowaidi, iya dova tauvada'abi yauyaulena yana wahuwahu namonamo ainai i'a'abine,
na mulitai 'wesu mwala'ina italu na abaita isagena na hinage yaumai mwala'ina itowa mata vadanane ibuiyei na i'oilo'elo'e moiha.’
Haugana ve'itaone teina Yeisu ive'ovidi bodaone nuwadi hipwanopwano,
na hiwalo, ‘Ve'ita teina dumwadumwaluna na wahiwahiyalana, na ita yada loina ana tauve'itao yadi ve'ita tapitapiyadi’.
